There are a ton of new updates that have been pushed to Bass Toolkit, bringing it to it's 100'th commit! Some of the most notable are:
- Expanded microG options (including CalyxOS microG source)
- Updated boot options for desktop, lockdown, tablet, restricted launcher, and more
- Added build flag to include @xtr1260 's ax86 Start Menu app (for use with Launcher3's Taskbar)
- Updated ADB secure flags
- Added build option to enable SystemUI Blur
- Updated Restricted Launcher apps
- Widened scope of our platform/release key generation scripts
- And much more (some hidden treasures)

Checkout the source:
https://github.com/Bliss-Bass/bass-os
